metadata.description: Plugins for automating the software development lifecycle with GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: autodev
plugins.description: Plans and implements software changes through two orchestrated workflows: autodev-plan drafts a plan hardened by isolated architecture, security, and privacy review gates with a live workflow canvas, and autodev-implement builds it milestone by milestone, hardened by isolated code, security, and privacy review loops.

plugins.name: autodev-factory
plugins.description: Runs the full plan-then-implement software development loop as a single Agent Factory, pausing for your approval before the review gates, before implementation, and at the code checkpoint.
